# AfriCompli UK

> AI-powered SRS and ESG compliance for African-founded and overseas businesses operating in the UK.

AfriCompli translates the opaque language of UK sustainability regulation into **actionable checklists, evidence-ready roadmaps, and filing-ready reports** — automating 90% of SRS compliance tasks.

Mandatory reporting under **UK SRS 1 & 2 begins January 2027**. Up to 2,186 overseas companies are directly exposed. AfriCompli is built specifically for them.

---

## What We Are Building

| Product | Description |
|---|---|
| **AI Compliance SaaS** | NLP engine maps 500+ UK regulatory obligations to each business profile — generates checklists, heat maps, and SRS-ready reports |
| **AfriLaw™ Mobile App** | Offline-first mobile companion for diaspora founders — AI Q&A, legal templates, filing alerts, consultant booking |
| **Consulting Layer** | Human expert review for ESG readiness audits, SRS report sign-off, and investor disclosure preparation |
| **Education Hub** | Compliance bootcamps, webinars, and accelerator partnerships across the UK |

---

## Who We Serve

- African-founded SMEs and fintechs operating in the UK
- Overseas businesses with indirect SRS exposure through UK supply chains
- Law firms, accelerators, and advisors serving overseas founders

---

## Current Stage

AfriCompli UK is in **early product development and pilot validation**. This organisation contains product briefs, MVP documentation, design references, and roadmap materials.

No code in this repository constitutes a live or production system.
